notes.subject: ינין
notes.rationale: Root נון 'sprout by shoots': KJV 'continued' vs literal 'shall sprout/propagate' — rendered with the growing-shoot picture kept.

notes.subject: ויתברכו בו
notes.rationale: Reflexive 'bless themselves by him' (JPS/ylt) vs passive 'be blessed in him' (KJV); Tok Pisin leaves it open with 'blesim olgeta long en'.

notes.subject: i tok em i gutpela man
notes.rationale: יאשרוהו is literally 'call him happy/straight', not 'bless'.

translation: Nem bilong en i ken stap olgeta taim; pastaim long san, nem bilong en i wok i gramboun olsem pikinini bilong diwai; na olgeta manmeri i ken blesim olgeta long en; olgeta ol kantri i tok em i gutpela man.
